num: Max results per query (default 15; pages controlled by `--pages`, default 1).
country: DuckDuckGo `kl` country code. `--region` is a legacy alias. Default `br`.
queries-file: File with additional queries (one per line). Empty lines ignored.
endpoint: `html` (default production) or `lite` (legacy value only; not a production success path under GAP-WS-113).
vertical: `web`, `news`, or `all` (**default `all`** since v0.9.8). News is Chrome-only.
identity-profile: Pin a 12-identity pool profile (`chrome-win`, `safari-mac`, …). Default `auto` rotates on block.
cookies-path: Override cookie jar path (default: XDG config dir + `cookies.json`).
seed: Deterministic seed for UA + identity selection (debug reproducibility).
config: Path to configuration directory (overrides default OS config path).
output: Write to file instead of stdout (creates parents; Unix 0o644).
stream: Multi-query: emit NDJSON as each search completes. Alias: `-f ndjson`. Early close → exit **141**.
fields: Project each result row to listed wire fields (comma-separated; EN or PT tokens).
filter: Filter result rows after SERP extract (agent-native; no jq).
limit: Cap result rows **after** extract + `--filter` (agent-native; no jq).
sort: Sort result rows after filter (agent-native; no jq).
dedupe-by: Deduplicate rows by canonical URL after sort (agent-native; no jq).
count-only: Emit only compact EN counts — no result rows.
truncate-content: Truncate each row `content` to N Unicode scalars (anti-token).
max-output-bytes: Fail-closed if formatted stdout payload exceeds N bytes.
pretty: Indented JSON (`to_string_pretty`). Default is **compact** JSON for agent token budgets.
print-schema: Print JSON Schema catalog on stdout (same as `schema` without `--name`).
ui-lang: UI language for human stderr (`en`|`pt-BR`). **Not** SERP `-l`/`--lang`.
config-home: Override XDG/platform config directory (selectors, cookies, ui-lang).
wire-keys: Serialize JSON keys as English (`en`, **v1.0.2 default**) or legacy Portuguese (`pt`). Also `config set wire_keys`.
shared-session-verticals: Force one shared Chrome session for web+news (`--vertical all`) instead of dual multi-process Chromes.
pages: Pages per query (`1..=5`, default **1**; may auto-raise with `--num`).
retries: Extra retries on transient HTTP/network failures (`0..=10`, default 2).
disable-retry: Force zero retries (incident kill switch). Equivalent to `--retries 0`.
proxy: HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxy via CLI (product does **not** inherit `HTTP(S)_PROXY`).
allow-lite-fallback: **LEGACY NO-OP (GAP-WS-113)** — does not force Lite; SERP stays HTML Chrome. Kept so scripts do not exit 2 on unknown flag.
global-timeout: Whole-pipeline timeout (`1..=3600` s, default 180). Distinct from per-request `--timeout`. Global on subcommands.
cancel-grace-secs: Cooperative cancel grace before hard exit (`1..=60` s, default 5).
probe: Chrome health probe via CDP: minimal reachability + latency as JSON.
verbose: `-v` = DEBUG, `-vv`+ = TRACE on stderr. Product log = CLI `-v`/`-q` + XDG `log_directive` (not `RUST_LOG`).
no-input: Agent contract: never prompt / never read interactive TTY.
probe-deep: Deep Chrome/CDP health check including interstitial (CAPTCHA) detection; JSON report.
require-results: Fail with exit 5 when search returns zero results (agent gate). Deep-research may use exit 70 in require mode.
pre-flight: Pre-flight ghost-block / interstitial calibration on shared Chrome SERP. Does **not** unlock pure-HTTP or Lite (GAP-WS-113). Web vertical only.
no-zero-cause-strict: Disable strict zero-cause mapping (legacy exit 5 for all zeros). Default strict ON → exit 6 for non-legitimate zeros.
fetch-content: Affirms content extraction (**default ON** since v0.9.8 for web+news). Prefer omit or use `--no-fetch-content`.
no-fetch-content: Disable page content extraction (opt-out of v0.9.8 agent-ready default).
fetch-content-cap: Max URLs to enrich per vertical (`1..=50`, default **4** in v1.0.2; was 10 at v0.9.8).
max-content-length: Max characters of extracted body per page (`1..=100_000`, default 10000).
per-host-limit: Concurrent fetches per host under content fetch (`1..=10`, default 2).
match-platform-ua: Filter UA pool to current OS when external `user-agents.toml` is present.
chrome-path: Manual Chrome/Chromium executable for all production network ops. Multi-channel (v0.9.8): Flatpak export→ELF. Global after `deep-research`.
chrome-visible: Force headed Chrome (visible window). Debug override.
chrome-headless: Force headless Chrome (`--headless=new`). Overrides Xvfb auto path.
chrome-xvfb: Request private Xvfb headed mode on Linux (invisible headed anti-bot).
chrome-session-retries: Additional Chrome session launch attempts after the first (transient CDP; default 2).
dump-news-html: Write news SERP HTML after Chrome extract to this path (local debug only).
no-warmup: Skip warm-up `GET https://duckduckgo.com/` that populates session cookies.
no-cookie-persistence: Keep cookies in memory only; never write the jar to disk.
max-sub-queries: Max sub-queries from decomposition (`1..=12`, default **3** in v1.0.2).
sub-queries-file: File with explicit sub-queries for deep-research (one per line).
synth-format: Synthesis output format for deep-research report.
synthesize: Enable LLM/report synthesis step in deep-research.
allow-under-budget: Allow proceeding when estimated budget is under the requested profile.
print-budget: Dry-run budget estimate without Chrome / without inventing a placeholder query.
require-all-sub-queries: Fail if any sub-query does not complete successfully.
no-news: Opt out of the news vertical in deep-research (news is default on).
strict: Doctor: fail closed on non-OK checks.
name: schema: emit a named schema body instead of the catalog.
file: man: write roff to this path (atomic). Uses `--file`, not `-o`.
